title: 第17章
content: 江南三中高三（7）班的教室，闷热得如同蒸笼。林宇握着橡皮的手微微出汗，试卷上那一道道晦涩难懂的矩阵方程和复杂的cad图纸，像一张张狰狞的面孔，死死盯着他。距离考试结束只剩半小时，可他的答题纸上，除了几个凌乱的草稿，几乎还是一片空白。“这根本不是高三物理该有的题目！”林宇在心里暗骂。他又瞥了一眼监考老师老王，对方正靠着讲台，百无聊赖地翻看着手机。教室里只听得见笔尖划过纸张的沙沙声，以及窗外断断续续的蝉鸣。就在林宇准备放弃，随便写点什么应付过去时，突然，他手中的橡皮在草稿纸上擦出一道奇异的荧光。林宇一愣，下意识地揉了揉眼睛，以为是自己看花了。可那荧光不仅没有消失，反而越来越亮，在白色的草稿纸上勾勒出一行小字：“检测到‘应龙-6’核心参数，科技推演系统启动。”“什么？”林宇差点叫出声来，好在及时捂住了嘴。他惊恐地环顾四周，生怕被别人发现这诡异的一幕。可教室里一切如常，同学们都在埋头答题，老王依旧沉浸在手机世界里。还没等林宇反应过来，他的视网膜上突然浮现出一个半透明的蓝色界面，像是科幻电影里的全息投影。界面上，试卷上那些复杂的图纸正在自动拆解，一个个零件如同被无形的手分开，在空中旋转、重组。一个冰冷的机械音在他脑海中响起：“反重力场生成模块解析度78%。”林宇感觉自己的太阳穴突突直跳，大脑仿佛被塞进了一团乱麻。这到底是怎么回事？难道是自己压力太大，出现幻觉了？可那界面和声音如此真实，真实得让他不寒而栗。就在这时，窗外传来一阵低沉的轰鸣声，一架涂装特殊的直升机快速掠过。林宇下意识地看向窗外，阳光透过玻璃洒在他脸上，刺得他眯起了眼睛。当他再回过头时，却发现教室中的粉笔灰仿佛受到了某种神秘力量的牵引，在空中排列成一串串不断流动的数据流。更诡异的是，他的嘴里泛起一股金属甜味，喉咙发紧，像是吞了一团带电的丝线。“这……这不可能……”林宇喃喃自语，双手死死抓住课桌边缘，指节因为用力而发白。系统界面上，解析度还在不断上升：“79%……80%……”随着数字跳动，那些原本天书般的公式和图纸，在他脑海中逐渐变得清晰起来。他突然理解了“矢量喷口偏转角度”的精妙之处，明白了“材料应力系数”背后的物理原理。林宇的呼吸变得急促起来，一种前所未有的兴奋感涌上心头。他拿起笔，开始在答题纸上飞速书写。每写下一个公式，草稿纸上就会自动生成对应的推导过程，仿佛有一双无形的手在帮助他。当他写到“反重力场生成模块”的关键部分时，系统突然发出警告：“警告！检测到外部干扰，解析速度下降！”林宇心头一紧，抬头看去，却发现老王不知何时已经放下手机，正皱着眉头盯着他。两人目光对视的瞬间，林宇感觉老王的眼神里充满了怀疑和警惕。“难道他发现了什么？”林宇心中暗想，握笔的手微微颤抖。就在这时，系统再次传来机械音：“启动伪装程序。”下一秒，林宇视网膜上的界面突然消失，他低头看向答题纸，那些系统生成的精妙答案，此刻竟变成了一道道普通的高三物理题解答。而老王看了一会儿，又重新坐下，继续摆弄起手机。林宇松了一口气，知道这是系统在保护自己。他定了定神，继续答题。有了系统的帮助，剩下的题目对他来说已经毫无难度。他甚至开始对试卷上的设计提出改进意见，当他写下“建议采用量子纠缠通讯替代微波链路”时，老王的智能手表突然发出刺耳的警报声，屏幕上的时间猛地倒退回三分钟前。老王脸色大变，手忙脚乱地摆弄着手表。而林宇则趁着这个机会，快速完成了最后的答题。考试结束铃声响起时，他自信地放下笔，看着自己满满当当的答题纸，心中涌起一股难以名状的成就感。然而，正当他准备起身交卷时，系统突然发出尖锐的警报：“危险！检测到未知能量波动，来源：教学楼顶层！”林宇还没来得及反应，就感觉整栋教学楼剧烈晃动起来，天花板上的吊灯左右摇摆，灰尘簌簌落下。教室里顿时一片混乱，同学们尖叫着四处躲藏，老王大声呼喊着维持秩序。林宇在混乱中迅速冷静下来，他的视网膜上再次浮现出系统界面，上面显示着一个红色的能量波纹图案，不断闪烁。“这到底是什么东西？”林宇心中疑惑，同时又隐隐感到一丝不安。他本能地觉得，这一切都和自己突然获得的系统有关。就在这时，一个熟悉的身影出现在教室门口——是赵天雷。他脸上带着诡异的笑容，手中拿着一个黑色的装置，上面的指示灯疯狂闪烁。林宇心中一沉，他立刻意识到，这个装置很可能就是系统检测到的“未知能量波动”来源。“林宇，没想到吧？”赵天雷大摇大摆地走进教室，眼神中充满了得意和挑衅，“你以为你能顺利答完这份试卷，就能出人头地了？太天真了！”林宇皱起眉头，冷冷地问道：“你到底在搞什么鬼？”赵天雷哈哈一笑：“实话告诉你，这份试卷就是个陷阱！那些题目，根本不是给你做的，而是用来检测你的！现在，你的秘密已经被我发现了……”“检测？检测什么？”林宇心中一惊，他本能地后退一步，同时在心中呼唤系统：“系统，这到底是怎么回事？”系统的机械音再次响起：“检测到敌意目标，启动防御机制。建议宿主立即撤离。”然而，已经来不及了。赵天雷按下手中装置的一个按钮，教室中的空气突然变得扭曲起来，一道黑色的裂缝在林宇面前缓缓打开。一股强大的吸力从裂缝中传来，林宇感觉自己的身体不受控制地向前飞去。“不！”林宇奋力挣扎，他抓住身边的课桌，可课桌在强大的吸力下，如同纸片一般被轻易扯走。就在他即将被吸入裂缝的千钧一发之际，系统突然爆发出一道耀眼的蓝光。蓝光笼罩着林宇的身体，形成一个能量护盾，将吸力硬生生挡了回去。赵天雷见状，脸色大变：“这怎么可能？！”他不甘心地再次按下装置，裂缝变得更大，吸力也更强了。但系统的能量护盾却岿然不动，反而开始反击。一道蓝色的能量束从护盾中射出，直奔赵天雷而去。赵天雷惊恐地躲避，可能量束紧追不舍，最终击中了他手中的装置。装置发出一声巨响，爆炸开来。赵天雷被气浪掀翻在地，狼狈不堪。而那道黑色裂缝，也在装置爆炸的同时，缓缓消失。教室里一片寂静，所有人都目瞪口呆地看着这一幕。林宇站在原地，心跳如雷。他知道，从这一刻起，自己的生活将彻底改变。而他和赵天雷之间的恩怨，才刚刚开始。“这……这到底是怎么回事？”老王颤抖着声音问道，脸上写满了恐惧和疑惑。林宇深吸一口气，缓缓说道：“我也不知道该怎么解释，但我可以肯定，这一切都和那份试卷有关……”他的目光扫过地上昏迷的赵天雷，心中暗自下定决心：“不管前方有多少危险，我都要弄清楚这个系统的秘密，以及赵天雷背后的阴谋！”此时，窗外的天空不知何时已经变得乌云密布，一道闪电划破天际，照亮了林宇坚毅的脸庞。而在他的脑海中，系统的机械音再次响起：“威胁暂时解除。宿主已引起未知势力注意，建议尽快提升实力。”林宇握紧拳头，默默回应：“我一定会的。”
content_en: The classroom of Class 7, Grade 3, Jiangnan No. 3 Middle School was as stuffy as a steamer.Lin Yu's hand holding the eraser was sweating slightly. The obscure matrix equations and complex CAD drawings on the test paper were like ferocious faces, staring at him.There was only half an hour left before the end of the exam, but his answer sheet was almost blank except for a few messy drafts."This is not a topic that senior high school physics should have at all!" Lin Yu cursed in his heart.He glanced at the invigilator Lao Wang again, who was leaning on the podium and looking at his phone boredly.In the classroom, the only sounds that could be heard were the rustling of the pen tip across the paper, and the intermittent chirping of cicadas outside the window.Just when Lin Yu was about to give up and just write something to deal with it, suddenly, the eraser in his hand wiped out a strange fluorescence on the draft paper.Lin Yu was stunned and rubbed his eyes subconsciously, thinking that he was seeing things.But the fluorescence not only did not disappear, but became brighter and brighter. A line of small words was sketched on the white draft paper: "The core parameters of 'Yinglong-6' were detected, and the scientific and technological deduction system was started." "What?" Lin Yu almost screamed, but fortunately he covered his mouth in time.He looked around in horror, fearing that others would discover this strange scene.But everything in the classroom was as usual, the students were all immersed in answering questions, and Lao Wang was still immersed in the world of mobile phones.Before Lin Yu could react, a translucent blue interface suddenly appeared on his retina, like a holographic projection in a science fiction movie.On the interface, the complex drawings on the test paper are being disassembled automatically. The parts seem to be separated by invisible hands, rotating and reorganizing in the air.A cold mechanical voice sounded in his mind: "The resolution of the anti-gravity field generation module is 78%." Lin Yu felt his temples pounding, and his brain seemed to be stuffed into a mess.What the hell is going on?Could it be that he was under too much pressure and hallucinating?But the interface and sound were so real that it made him shudder.At this moment, there was a low roar outside the window, and a specially painted helicopter flew past quickly.Lin Yu subconsciously looked out the window. The sunlight shone on his face through the glass, causing him to squint his eyes.When he looked back, he found that the chalk dust in the classroom seemed to be pulled by some mysterious force, forming a series of continuously flowing data streams in the air.What's even weirder is that there's a metallic sweetness in his mouth, and his throat feels tight, as if he's swallowed a ball of electrified thread."This... this is impossible..." Lin Yu muttered to himself, grabbing the edge of the desk with both hands, his knuckles turning white from the exertion.On the system interface, the resolution is still rising: "79%...80%..." As the numbers jump, the formulas and drawings that were originally like a heavenly book gradually become clear in his mind.He suddenly understood the subtleties of the "vector nozzle deflection angle" and the physical principles behind the "material stress coefficient".Lin Yu's breathing became rapid, and an unprecedented sense of excitement filled his heart.He picked up the pen and started writing quickly on the answer sheet.Every time he writes down a formula, the corresponding derivation process will automatically be generated on the draft paper, as if a pair of invisible hands are helping him.When he wrote the key part of the "anti-gravity field generation module", the system suddenly issued a warning: "Warning! External interference has been detected, and the analysis speed has decreased!" Lin Yu's heart tightened, and when he looked up, he found that Lao Wang had put down his cell phone at some point and was staring at him with a frown.The moment the two looked at each other, Lin Yu felt that Lao Wang's eyes were full of suspicion and vigilance."Did he discover something?" Lin Yu thought to himself, the hand holding the pen trembling slightly.At this moment, a mechanical voice came from the system again: "Start the disguise program." The next second, the interface on Lin Yu's retina suddenly disappeared. He lowered his head and looked at the answer sheet. The exquisite answers generated by the system turned into ordinary high school physics questions.Lao Wang watched for a while, then sat down again and continued to fiddle with his phone.Lin Yu breathed a sigh of relief, knowing that the system was protecting him.He composed himself and continued to answer the questions.With the help of the system, the remaining questions were no longer difficult for him.He even started to make suggestions for improving the design on the test paper. When he wrote "It is recommended to use quantum entanglement communication to replace the microwave link," Lao Wang's smart watch suddenly sounded a piercing alarm, and the time on the screen suddenly went back to three minutes ago.Lao Wang's expression changed drastically and he fiddled with his watch hurriedly.Lin Yu took advantage of this opportunity to quickly complete the final answer.When the bell rang at the end of the exam, he put down his pen confidently, looked at his answer sheet full of questions, and felt an indescribable sense of accomplishment in his heart.However, just as he was about to get up and hand in the paper, the system suddenly issued a sharp alarm: "Danger! Unknown energy fluctuations detected, source: the top floor of the teaching building!" Before Lin Yu had time to react, he felt the entire teaching building shaking violently, the chandelier on the ceiling swinging left and right, and dust falling.The classroom suddenly became chaotic, with students screaming and hiding in all directions, and Lao Wang shouting loudly to maintain order.Lin Yu quickly calmed down in the chaos, and the system interface appeared on his retina again, showing a red energy ripple pattern that kept flashing."What on earth is this?" Lin Yu was confused and felt a little uneasy at the same time.He instinctively felt that all this was related to the system he suddenly acquired.At this moment, a familiar figure appeared at the door of the classroom—Zhao Tianlei.He had a weird smile on his face and held a black device in his hand, with the indicator lights on it flashing crazily.Lin Yu's heart sank, and he immediately realized that this device was probably the source of the "unknown energy fluctuations" detected by the system."Lin Yu, didn't you expect that?" Zhao Tianlei swaggered into the classroom, his eyes full of pride and provocation, "Do you think you can get ahead if you can successfully answer this test paper? You are so naive!" Lin Yu frowned and asked coldly: "What the hell are you doing?" Zhao Tianlei laughed: "To tell you the truth, this test paper is a trap! Those questions are not for you at all.It's to detect you!Now, your secret has been discovered..." "Detection?What?" Lin Yu was startled, and he instinctively took a step back, calling the system in his heart: "System, what's going on?" The system's mechanical voice sounded again: "Hostile target detected, the host is advised to evacuate immediately."Zhao Tianlei pressed a button on the device in his hand, and the air in the classroom suddenly became distorted, and a black crack slowly opened in front of Lin Yu.A strong suction force came from the crack, and Lin Yu felt his body flying forward uncontrollably."No!" Lin Yu struggled hard and grabbed the desk beside him, but the desk was easily pulled away like a piece of paper under the strong suction.Just when he was about to be sucked into the crack, the system suddenly erupted with a dazzling blue light.Blue light enveloped Lin Yu's body, forming an energy shield that blocked the suction force.When Zhao Tianlei saw this, his expression changed drastically: "How is this possible?!" He reluctantly pressed the device again, and the cracks became larger and the suction force became stronger.But the system's energy shield remained motionless and began to fight back.A blue energy beam shot out of the shield and headed straight for Zhao Tianlei.Zhao Tianlei evaded in horror, but he kept chasing after him, and finally hit the device in his hand.The device exploded with a loud bang.Zhao Tianlei was knocked to the ground by the air wave and was in a miserable state.And the black crack slowly disappeared at the same time as the device exploded.There was silence in the classroom, and everyone stared at this scene in stunned silence.Lin Yu stood there, his heart beating like thunder.He knew that from this moment on, his life would completely change.And the grudge between him and Zhao Tianlei has just begun."What...what is going on?" Lao Wang asked with a trembling voice, his face full of fear and doubt.Lin Yu took a deep breath and said slowly: "I don't know how to explain it, but I am sure that it is all related to that test paper..." His eyes swept over the unconscious Zhao Tianlei on the ground, and he secretly made up his mind: "No matter how many dangers there are ahead, I will figure out the secrets of this system and the conspiracy behind Zhao Tianlei!" At this time, the sky outside the window had become dark clouds at some point, and a bolt of lightning pierced the sky, illuminating Lin Yu's resolute face.In his mind, the system's mechanical sound sounded again: "The threat is temporarily lifted. The host has attracted the attention of unknown forces, and it is recommended to increase its strength as soon as possible." Lin Yu clenched his fists and responded silently: "I will definitely do it."
content_zh: 江南三中高三（7）班的教室，闷热得如同蒸笼。林宇握着橡皮的手微微出汗，试卷上那一道道晦涩难懂的矩阵方程和复杂的cad图纸，像一张张狰狞的面孔，死死盯着他。距离考试结束只剩半小时，可他的答题纸上，除了几个凌乱的草稿，几乎还是一片空白。“这根本不是高三物理该有的题目！”林宇在心里暗骂。他又瞥了一眼监考老师老王，对方正靠着讲台，百无聊赖地翻看着手机。教室里只听得见笔尖划过纸张的沙沙声，以及窗外断断续续的蝉鸣。就在林宇准备放弃，随便写点什么应付过去时，突然，他手中的橡皮在草稿纸上擦出一道奇异的荧光。林宇一愣，下意识地揉了揉眼睛，以为是自己看花了。可那荧光不仅没有消失，反而越来越亮，在白色的草稿纸上勾勒出一行小字：“检测到‘应龙-6’核心参数，科技推演系统启动。”“什么？”林宇差点叫出声来，好在及时捂住了嘴。他惊恐地环顾四周，生怕被别人发现这诡异的一幕。可教室里一切如常，同学们都在埋头答题，老王依旧沉浸在手机世界里。还没等林宇反应过来，他的视网膜上突然浮现出一个半透明的蓝色界面，像是科幻电影里的全息投影。界面上，试卷上那些复杂的图纸正在自动拆解，一个个零件如同被无形的手分开，在空中旋转、重组。一个冰冷的机械音在他脑海中响起：“反重力场生成模块解析度78%。”林宇感觉自己的太阳穴突突直跳，大脑仿佛被塞进了一团乱麻。这到底是怎么回事？难道是自己压力太大，出现幻觉了？可那界面和声音如此真实，真实得让他不寒而栗。就在这时，窗外传来一阵低沉的轰鸣声，一架涂装特殊的直升机快速掠过。林宇下意识地看向窗外，阳光透过玻璃洒在他脸上，刺得他眯起了眼睛。当他再回过头时，却发现教室中的粉笔灰仿佛受到了某种神秘力量的牵引，在空中排列成一串串不断流动的数据流。更诡异的是，他的嘴里泛起一股金属甜味，喉咙发紧，像是吞了一团带电的丝线。“这……这不可能……”林宇喃喃自语，双手死死抓住课桌边缘，指节因为用力而发白。系统界面上，解析度还在不断上升：“79%……80%……”随着数字跳动，那些原本天书般的公式和图纸，在他脑海中逐渐变得清晰起来。他突然理解了“矢量喷口偏转角度”的精妙之处，明白了“材料应力系数”背后的物理原理。林宇的呼吸变得急促起来，一种前所未有的兴奋感涌上心头。他拿起笔，开始在答题纸上飞速书写。每写下一个公式，草稿纸上就会自动生成对应的推导过程，仿佛有一双无形的手在帮助他。当他写到“反重力场生成模块”的关键部分时，系统突然发出警告：“警告！检测到外部干扰，解析速度下降！”林宇心头一紧，抬头看去，却发现老王不知何时已经放下手机，正皱着眉头盯着他。两人目光对视的瞬间，林宇感觉老王的眼神里充满了怀疑和警惕。“难道他发现了什么？”林宇心中暗想，握笔的手微微颤抖。就在这时，系统再次传来机械音：“启动伪装程序。”下一秒，林宇视网膜上的界面突然消失，他低头看向答题纸，那些系统生成的精妙答案，此刻竟变成了一道道普通的高三物理题解答。而老王看了一会儿，又重新坐下，继续摆弄起手机。林宇松了一口气，知道这是系统在保护自己。他定了定神，继续答题。有了系统的帮助，剩下的题目对他来说已经毫无难度。他甚至开始对试卷上的设计提出改进意见，当他写下“建议采用量子纠缠通讯替代微波链路”时，老王的智能手表突然发出刺耳的警报声，屏幕上的时间猛地倒退回三分钟前。老王脸色大变，手忙脚乱地摆弄着手表。而林宇则趁着这个机会，快速完成了最后的答题。考试结束铃声响起时，他自信地放下笔，看着自己满满当当的答题纸，心中涌起一股难以名状的成就感。然而，正当他准备起身交卷时，系统突然发出尖锐的警报：“危险！检测到未知能量波动，来源：教学楼顶层！”林宇还没来得及反应，就感觉整栋教学楼剧烈晃动起来，天花板上的吊灯左右摇摆，灰尘簌簌落下。教室里顿时一片混乱，同学们尖叫着四处躲藏，老王大声呼喊着维持秩序。林宇在混乱中迅速冷静下来，他的视网膜上再次浮现出系统界面，上面显示着一个红色的能量波纹图案，不断闪烁。“这到底是什么东西？”林宇心中疑惑，同时又隐隐感到一丝不安。他本能地觉得，这一切都和自己突然获得的系统有关。就在这时，一个熟悉的身影出现在教室门口——是赵天雷。他脸上带着诡异的笑容，手中拿着一个黑色的装置，上面的指示灯疯狂闪烁。林宇心中一沉，他立刻意识到，这个装置很可能就是系统检测到的“未知能量波动”来源。“林宇，没想到吧？”赵天雷大摇大摆地走进教室，眼神中充满了得意和挑衅，“你以为你能顺利答完这份试卷，就能出人头地了？太天真了！”林宇皱起眉头，冷冷地问道：“你到底在搞什么鬼？”赵天雷哈哈一笑：“实话告诉你，这份试卷就是个陷阱！那些题目，根本不是给你做的，而是用来检测你的！现在，你的秘密已经被我发现了……”“检测？检测什么？”林宇心中一惊，他本能地后退一步，同时在心中呼唤系统：“系统，这到底是怎么回事？”系统的机械音再次响起：“检测到敌意目标，启动防御机制。建议宿主立即撤离。”然而，已经来不及了。赵天雷按下手中装置的一个按钮，教室中的空气突然变得扭曲起来，一道黑色的裂缝在林宇面前缓缓打开。一股强大的吸力从裂缝中传来，林宇感觉自己的身体不受控制地向前飞去。“不！”林宇奋力挣扎，他抓住身边的课桌，可课桌在强大的吸力下，如同纸片一般被轻易扯走。就在他即将被吸入裂缝的千钧一发之际，系统突然爆发出一道耀眼的蓝光。蓝光笼罩着林宇的身体，形成一个能量护盾，将吸力硬生生挡了回去。赵天雷见状，脸色大变：“这怎么可能？！”他不甘心地再次按下装置，裂缝变得更大，吸力也更强了。但系统的能量护盾却岿然不动，反而开始反击。一道蓝色的能量束从护盾中射出，直奔赵天雷而去。赵天雷惊恐地躲避，可能量束紧追不舍，最终击中了他手中的装置。装置发出一声巨响，爆炸开来。赵天雷被气浪掀翻在地，狼狈不堪。而那道黑色裂缝，也在装置爆炸的同时，缓缓消失。教室里一片寂静，所有人都目瞪口呆地看着这一幕。林宇站在原地，心跳如雷。他知道，从这一刻起，自己的生活将彻底改变。而他和赵天雷之间的恩怨，才刚刚开始。“这……这到底是怎么回事？”老王颤抖着声音问道，脸上写满了恐惧和疑惑。林宇深吸一口气，缓缓说道：“我也不知道该怎么解释，但我可以肯定，这一切都和那份试卷有关……”他的目光扫过地上昏迷的赵天雷，心中暗自下定决心：“不管前方有多少危险，我都要弄清楚这个系统的秘密，以及赵天雷背后的阴谋！”此时，窗外的天空不知何时已经变得乌云密布，一道闪电划破天际，照亮了林宇坚毅的脸庞。而在他的脑海中，系统的机械音再次响起：“威胁暂时解除。宿主已引起未知势力注意，建议尽快提升实力。”林宇握紧拳头，默默回应：“我一定会的。”
